ACSA (Association for Computer Science Aspirants) is a vibrant student association established by the Department
of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at SV College of Engineering. True to its name, ACSA serves as a
dynamic platform for CSE students to showcase and strengthen their technical expertise and communication
abilities.
The association regularly conducts a wide range of events, workshops, technical sessions, and competitions, all
designed to nurture the professional potential of students and to equip them with the skills required to meet
future challenges in the field of Computer Science and Engineering.
